newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal leaves fixed rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal leaves fixed rates unchanged.

text.p: LISBON, June 3 (Reute) - The Bank of Portugal offered a 280 billion escudo variable rate repurchase pact but left its fixed money market rates unchanged on Tuesday for the start of a new commercial bank reserve period.
Bids for the funds must be received by 1415 GMT.
The drain, or absorption rate remains at 5.7 percent while the emergency lending rate stays at 7.7 percent.
